dedupe_keys.name: taranaki basin pre drill geohazard assessment dataset

description: Science Data Bank publishes a dataset for pre-drill geohazard assessment in New Zealand's Taranaki Basin. Its registry describes geology, geophysics, drilled wells and interpreted overpressure information under CC BY 4.0, free to access. The article reports 17 seismic attributes along well trajectories and labels for safe formations, wellbore collapse, overpressure and combined hazards. These examples can train or test models of drilling risk for oil, gas or geothermal well infrastructure. The observations and hazard labels are tied to a particular sedimentary basin; they are not a general probability map for every well design or a validated forecast elsewhere. Interpretation and class balance may affect learning results, and users should inspect the file schema and split wells by location before claiming predictive skill. The article describes three neural-network benchmarks, but the inspected sources did not provide a separate code repository or trained model address. It complements data-usgs-mrdata-mineral-resources-online-spatial-data only as a distinct subsurface information source. No dataset file was downloaded.
